ai_review.summary: The recording receives mixed reactions – one reviewer finds the new treatment tinny and lacking warmth, another praises its increased clarity – with no performance details available.

ai_rating.rationale: Only two reviews with opposing views on sound quality; no musical commentary to boost rating, so an average score reflects the mixed perception.
